claims.statement: Heater reading jumped to 410.89 at 69.6 on LOT-1231 from 399.54 at 69.3 on LOT-1230 and was still 410.2 at 72.0 on LOT-1239
Heater_temp_C recent mean 406.15 versus baseline 400.01 with z-score 34.2, while rf_power_W z-score 1.8, pressure_Torr z-score 2.4 and gas_flow_sccm z-score -0.5 show no other shift
Wafers spanning the heater jump show no thickening with means 497.11 on LOT-1229 and 498.82 on LOT-1230 and 499.44 on LOT-1232 after the jump

disposition.summary: Heater sensor on DEP01-A jumped high at 69.6 h but the next measured wafer LOT-1232 is still 499.44 with no thickening. Other FDC parameters are normal, so this is a sensor misreport with good film. Release the alarm lot and flag the heater sensor.
